title: Empirical Evaluation Protocol for Hybrid AML Anomaly Detection
description: Governs temporal and participant-disjoint experiments comparing rules-based, ML-only, and hybrid models. Splits are cutoff-based (R17): cutoffs are fixed here BEFORE training and are never derived from labels or result quality.

splits.cutoff_source: fixed in this config before training; never inferred from labels, split sizes, or evaluation results

policy_detail.validation: ONLY participants with first_seen > train_end AND last_seen <= validation_end, and their in-window records
policy_detail.test: ONLY participants with first_seen > validation_end, and their later records
policy_detail.later_records_of_train_participants: dropped, never migrated to compensate size
policy_detail.participants_crossing_validation_test: enter neither evaluation set; every drop is recorded with a reason

activation_policy.hybrid_activation_requires: PASSED research status computed by evaluate_gate on the strict temporal+participant-disjoint test split under acceptance_gates, AND recall >= rules-only baseline AND FPR <= baseline with a strict gain in at least one of the two (spec §9); activation binding additionally requires the evaluation seal and a model-artifact hash match (ModelRegistry.activate)
